title: PT_LOAD can have different lengths in file and memory
summary: p_filesz of PT_LOAD is the part carried by the file, and p_memsz is the size in memory; when the latter is larger, the tail is padded with zeros.
applies: ELF file; System V Common ABI
detail: The intra-segment offset d is smaller than p_filesz, which corresponds to the file position p_offset+d. If p_filesz ≤ d < p_memsz, the address can still belong to the segment.
boundary: For loadable segments, p_filesz must not be larger than p_memsz. The address mapping must also fall in the same segment.
relevance: When restoring static addresses to the original file, determine why there are no readable file bytes at certain addresses.
